title: Accept Proposal Request
description: Accept one committed immutable proposal. Depending on proposal_kind, acceptance creates a MediaBuy, applies an amendment, or applies a negotiated cancellation. The proposal already contains the commercial terms, so callers do not repeat packages, dates, targeting, or creatives.
x-tool-summary: Accept a committed proposal to create or amend a media buy, or apply a negotiated cancellation.

name.description: Human-readable MediaBuy name supplied by the buyer for trafficking UI display and operational communication. When supplied, this value wins over proposal.name; the seller MUST persist it and echo it unchanged on the commitment success response and subsequent get_media_buys reads. It is operational metadata outside accepted_proposal and is not covered by proposal_terms_digest or terms_digest. When an acceptance creates a MediaBuy and name is absent, the seller MAY seed the MediaBuy name from proposal.name only when proposal.name already satisfies the MediaBuy name constraints (non-whitespace and no longer than 255 characters); the seller MUST NOT silently truncate or otherwise rewrite it. A seeded value counts as a name created through AdCP and MUST be reported on commitment and read surfaces. This display label is not an identifier or financial reference.

proposal_terms_digest.description: terms_digest from the committed proposal. The seller MUST atomically verify both ID and digest before acceptance.

total_budget.description: Execution amount when the committed proposal defines scalable percentages or constraints rather than a fixed total.

daily_budget_cap.description: Optional hard aggregate daily spend ceiling applied when the committed proposal is accepted. It constrains execution without changing the proposal's negotiated pricing.

budget_cap_timezone.description: Optional shared IANA cap-day timezone override. Requires buyer_timezone_override support. When omitted, budget_capping.timezone_basis selects Account.timezone or fixed_timezone.

predecessor_media_buy_id.description: Media buy this one succeeds (renewal, migration, or sunset). Forward-only: set once at creation; the predecessor is never modified. MUST be an existing buy of the same seller and account, else `MEDIA_BUY_NOT_FOUND`. Requires `lineage_reason`. See the Media Buy Lineage section of the media-buy specification. Not allowed when the proposal's `proposal_kind` is `media_buy_update` or `media_buy_cancellation` (`INVALID_REQUEST`). Experimental in AdCP 3.3: sellers that implement it list `media_buy.lineage` in `experimental_features`, buyers send it only to sellers that do, and a seller that cannot record it rejects the request with `UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE`.

lineage_reason.description: Why this buy succeeds its predecessor. Supplied with, and only with, `predecessor_media_buy_id` (`INVALID_REQUEST` otherwise). Reasons outside the closed enum go in `ext`.

reporting_webhook.description: Optional reporting delivery configuration established atomically when the proposal is accepted. This is execution metadata and does not alter the accepted commercial terms digest.

opportunity.description: Optional planning-cycle closure. Success infers closed with accepted_with_seller when status is omitted. If the proposal carries opportunity_id, a supplied ID MUST match; the accepted proposal preserves that association.
